responsibility: Implements Scalar Replacement of Aggregates for GIMPLE, in both early and late intraprocedural forms. It identifies scalarizable aggregate candidates, records and organizes accesses by offset/size, rejects unsafe overlapping or escaping uses, propagates access trees through assignments, chooses promotable subobjects, rewrites statements and parameters to use new scalar replacements, and updates CFG/EH/SSA bookkeeping so aggregate fields become independent scalar variables for later optimization.
same_name_distinction: Implements the SRA passes themselves: candidate discovery, access analysis, propagation, statement rewriting, parameter scalarization setup, and early/late pass execution. Unlike the header, this is the transformation engine rather than a small set of SRA policy/helper routines.
